Carrier equality, the local binary DAG, the finite-tree induction, and the sign-admissibility recurrence are finite exact data, conditionally formalizable in PRA . The Green factor genuinely uses completed LF/Fréchet spaces, countable whole-eigenspace Hodge-projector convergence, smooth support cutoffs, and the imported globally-hyperbolic theorem. No infinite tree sum or new selection operation is introduced, but the weakest base and choice strength of that analytic theorem remain uncalibrated. Atlas V19 still ranks authoritative
